data.credibility: Management shows mixed reliability. They deliver on immediate sequential guidance like Q4 FY26 growth, but repeatedly miss annual margin targets (FY26 actual 18.9% vs 21% promised) and tend to drop or stop mentioning longer-term strategic metrics.

lines.line: Promised 21% FY26 EBITDA margin; delivered 18.9% according to exchange data.
Expected flattish to positive Q3 FY26 organic growth; missed with -1% actual.
Promised highest quarterly growth in Q4 FY26; delivered 12.0%.
Promised FY27 growth higher than FY26; dropped after achieving 7.6% over two quarters.
Expected FY27 EBITDA margin between 20.5% and 21.2%; dropped after tracking at 15.6%.
Expected 30% FY27 solutions growth; dropped after tracking at 7.6% over two quarters.
Expected solutions share to reach 60% in 3 years; dropped from subsequent updates.
Expected medium-term EBITDA of 22% to 24%; currently slipping with 15.6% actual.

bull: Revenue compounded at 26.0% annually and net profit at 34.1% over the past five years.
Operating cash flow reached 165% of reported profit over 5 years, showing strong cash conversion.
The balance sheet remains lightly geared with a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.21.
bear: FY26 EBITDA margin missed guidance at 18.9% compared to the promised 21%.
Current FY27 EBITDA margin tracks at 15.6%, falling short of the 20.5% to 21.2% target range.
Borrowings increased significantly from ₹230 cr in FY21 to ₹764 cr.
